headline: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE, Sandbox for AI Agents
dek: The company says the tool has run its Computer agents since July and is being tested by CoreWeave, Akamai and Crusoe.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: An isolated space for agents
body: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE, the sandbox it uses to run the AI agents behind Computer (Perplexity, SiliconANGLE).
According to the company, each agent runs in its own virtual machine, separate from the host computer.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: How SPACE protects
s3.body: According to Perplexity, the sandbox is treated as untrusted.

points.t: Network and keys stay outside the agent's environment (Perplexity).
A dashboard creates, pauses, resumes or removes environments (Perplexity).
Frequent snapshots keep work safe if a session drops (Perplexity).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Escape testing
body: Perplexity says that across more than a hundred escape attempts, no agent fully got out.
According to the company, network gaps found in testing were fixed and did not recur.

stat.cap: escape attempts in testing, Perplexity says

items.t: Published a guide for deploying SPACE (Perplexity, SiliconANGLE).
Tested it and went live on its own cloud (SiliconANGLE).
Is integrating SPACE into its managed AI services (SiliconANGLE).

caption.hook: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE, the sandbox that isolates the AI agents behind its Computer product.
body: According to Perplexity, each agent runs in its own virtual machine, with network access and credentials kept outside the environment. The company says SPACE has run every Computer session since July.

Perplexity says that across more than a hundred escape attempts in testing, no agent fully got out, and that network gaps found were fixed. According to the company and SiliconANGLE, CoreWeave, Akamai and Crusoe are already testing or integrating the tool.
